tooltip: Stream Mode – Allows you to set the streaming trigger mode of the camera
content1: Allows you to set the streaming trigger mode of the camera. The camera can operate in free-running master mode or wait for an external hardware trigger.
content2:
StreamModeCU135M Enum indicates the streaming trigger mode:
  1. MODE_MASTER (0x00) – Free-running (master) mode.
  2. MODE_TRIGGER (0x01) – External trigger mode.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current streaming trigger mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the streaming trigger mode of the camera.

tooltip: Flash Mode – Allows you to set the flash or torch output mode of the camera
content1: Allows you to configure the flash or torch output mode of the camera. The flash can be disabled, set to strobe for burst illumination, or set to continuous torch mode.
content2:
FlashModeCU135M Enum indicates the flash output mode:
  1. FLASH_OFF (0x00) – Flash disabled.
  2. FLASH_STROBE (0x01) – Strobe flash (burst illumination).
  3. FLASH_TORCH (0x02) – Continuous torch mode.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current flash/torch output mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the flash/torch output mode of the camera.

tooltip: ROI Auto-Exposure – Allows you to configure the auto-exposure region of interest
content1: Allows you to configure the region of interest (ROI) used for auto-exposure calculations. The ROI can cover the full frame or be set to a manual window with a specific position and size.
content2:
ROIAutoExpModeCU135M Enum indicates the ROI mode for auto-exposure:
  1. AE_Full (0x01) – Full-frame auto-exposure.
  2. AE_Manual (0x02) – Manual ROI window.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current auto-exposure ROI configuration including mode, mapped coordinates, and window size.
setAPIHeading: bool setAutoExpROIMode(ROIAutoExpModeCU135M roimode, uint32_t vidW, uint32_t vidH, uint32_t xCord, uint32_t yCord, uint8_t wnsize)
setAPIDes: This function configures the auto-exposure region of interest. In manual mode, specify the video frame dimensions and the desired ROI centre coordinates and window size.

tooltip: Target Brightness – Allows you to set the target brightness value for auto-exposure
content1: Allows you to set the target brightness level that the auto-exposure algorithm aims to achieve. The value must be within the valid min–max range reported by the camera.
content2:
BrightnessResultCU135M holds the brightness parameters returned by getBrightness():
  - min_value: Minimum allowed brightness.
  - max_value: Maximum allowed brightness.
  - value: Current brightness setting.
  - step_value: Increment step size.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current target brightness value along with the valid range and step size.
setAPIDes: This function sets the target brightness value for the auto-exposure algorithm.

tooltip: Auto-Exposure Mode – Allows you to set the auto-exposure trigger behaviour
content1: Allows you to configure how the auto-exposure algorithm is triggered. In continuous mode the exposure is adjusted continuously. In single-shot mode the exposure is calculated once per trigger.
content2:
ExposureModeCU135M Enum indicates the auto-exposure trigger behaviour:
  1. CONTINUOUS_EXPOSURE (0x00) – Continuous auto-exposure.
  2. SINGLE_SHOT_EXPOSURE (0x01) – Single-shot auto-exposure.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current auto-exposure trigger mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the auto-exposure trigger mode of the camera.

tooltip: Flip Control – Allows you to set the image flip or mirror orientation of the camera
content1: Allows you to flip the output image horizontally (mirror), vertically, both, or disable all flips. This is useful for correcting the image orientation based on the physical camera mounting.
content2:
FlipModeCU135M Enum indicates the flip/mirror orientation:
  1. FLIP_NORMAL (0x00) – No flip.
  2. FLIP_HORIZONTAL (0x01) – Horizontal flip (mirror).
  3. FLIP_VERTICAL (0x02) – Vertical flip.
  4. FLIP_BOTH (0x03) – Both horizontal and vertical flip.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current image flip/mirror orientation of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the image flip and mirror orientation of the camera. Pass true for the axis/axes you want to flip.

tooltip: Anti-Flicker Mode – Allows you to suppress fluorescent light flicker at 50 Hz or 60 Hz
content1: Allows you to enable anti-flicker suppression to reduce banding artefacts caused by fluorescent or LED lighting.
content2:
AntiFlickerCU135M Enum indicates the anti-flicker suppression mode:
  1. MODE_50Hz (0x00) – 50 Hz flicker suppression.
  2. MODE_60Hz (0x01) – 60 Hz flicker suppression.
  3. MODE_DISABLE (0x02) – Anti-flicker disabled.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current anti-flicker suppression mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the anti-flicker suppression mode of the camera.

tooltip: Statistics Data – Reads live auto-exposure and auto-gain statistics from the camera
content1: Reads the live auto-exposure (in microseconds) and auto-gain values currently being applied by the camera. This is a read-only operation useful for monitoring and diagnostics.
content2:
StatisticsResultCU135M holds the statistics returned by readStatistics():
  - exposure: Current auto-exposure value in microseconds (µs).
  - gain: Current auto-gain value.
getAPIDes: This function reads the live auto-exposure and auto-gain statistics from the camera.

tooltip: Blacklight Compensation – Enables or disables black-level correction on the camera
content1: Allows you to enable or disable black-level correction (black-level adjustment) on the camera. Enabling this feature improves image quality in high-contrast scenes with dark backgrounds.
content2:
BlackLevelAdjCU135M Enum indicates the black-level correction state:
  1. ENABLE (0x01) – Enable black-level correction.
  2. DISABLE (0x02) – Disable black-level correction.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current black-level correction state of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function enables or disables the black-level correction on the camera.

label: Gain Control
tooltip: Gain Control – Allows you to configure the gain control mode of the camera
content1: Allows you to configure the sensor gain control. In auto mode the gain is adjusted automatically (continuously or single-shot). In manual mode you can specify an explicit gain value via the slider.
content2:
GainModeCU135M Enum indicates the gain control mode:
  1. AUTO_GAIN (0x00) – Automatic gain control.
  2. MANUAL_GAIN (0x01) – Manual gain value.

AutoGainCU135M Enum indicates the auto-gain trigger behaviour:
  1. CONTINUOUS (0x00) – Continuously adjust gain.
  2. SINGLE_SHOT (0x01) – Single-shot gain adjustment.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current gain mode and all gain parameters including current value, range, and step size.
setAPIHeading: bool setAutoGainMode(GainModeCU135M gain_mode, AutoGainCU135M auto_gain_mode, uint16_t gain_value)
setAPIDes: This function configures the gain control mode. In auto mode set the auto_gain_mode parameter; in manual mode provide the desired gain_value.

tooltip: Auto Gain Limit – Allows you to set the lower and upper boundaries for automatic gain control
content1: Allows you to constrain the automatic gain control within a defined range by setting lower and upper gain limits. The lower limit must be less than or equal to the upper limit.
content2:
GainLimitResultCU135M holds the gain limit parameters returned by getAutoGainLimit():
  - lower_limit: Current lower gain limit.
  - upper_limit: Current upper gain limit.
  - min_value: Minimum achievable gain.
  - max_value: Maximum achievable gain.
  - step_value: Gain limit step size.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current auto-gain lower/upper limits and the valid slider range.
setAPIDes: This function sets the auto-gain lower and upper limits. The lower limit must be less than or equal to the upper limit.

tooltip: Auto Exposure Lower Limit – Allows you to set the minimum exposure time for the auto-exposure algorithm
content1: Allows you to set the minimum exposure time (in microseconds) that the auto-exposure algorithm is permitted to use. The value must be greater than or equal to EXPOSURE_LIMIT_MIN_CU135M_H01R1 and less than or equal to the current upper limit.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current auto-exposure lower limit in microseconds.
setAPIDes: This function sets the auto-exposure lower limit in microseconds.

tooltip: Auto Exposure Upper Limit – Allows you to set the maximum exposure time for the auto-exposure algorithm
content1: Allows you to set the maximum exposure time (in microseconds) that the auto-exposure algorithm is permitted to use. The value must be less than or equal to EXPOSURE_LIMIT_MAX_CU135M_H01R1 and greater than or equal to the current lower limit.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current auto-exposure upper limit in microseconds.
setAPIDes: This function sets the auto-exposure upper limit in microseconds.

tooltip: Serial Number – Reads the unique serial number from the camera
content1: Reads the unique 64-bit hardware identifier from the camera. This ID can be used to distinguish between multiple connected devices of the same model.
getAPIDes: This function reads the unique 64-bit hardware identifier of the camera and returns it as a string.

tooltip: Firmware Version – Reads the firmware version string from the camera
content1: Reads the firmware version string from the camera (e.g. "v1.0.3"). This is useful for verifying compatibility with a specific SDK release or for diagnostic reporting.
getAPIDes: This function reads the firmware version from the camera and returns it as a string.

name: Default
tooltip: Default – Restores all camera settings to their factory defaults
content1: Restores all camera settings to their factory default values. This affects stream mode, flash mode, flip orientation, auto-exposure, gain control, and all other configurable parameters.
getAPIDes: This function restores all camera settings to their factory defaults.
